subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should the dashboard A2UI bridge wait for the canonical browser Canvas action-ingress contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497, or define a dashboard-specific action path?
rationale: The request crosses a sandbox/browser-to-Gateway trust boundary and depends on unmerged dashboard substrate, so automation cannot choose the product/security contract safely.

options.title: Sequence through Canvas ingress first
options.body: Keep this issue open, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 as the canonical browser action-ingress contract, then adapt the dashboard bridge to that approved path.

options.title: Design a dashboard-owned action path
options.body: Allow dashboard widgets to own a separate action protocol, accepting the cost of a second browser A2UI action surface and a dedicated security review.

options.title: Defer until dashboard substrate lands
options.body: Pause implementation until the dashboard custom-widget host has a maintainer-approved landing path and then revisit the bridge shape.

recommendation.title: Sequence through Canvas ingress first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 as the canonical browser action-ingress contract, then adapt the dashboard bridge to that approved path.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the clearest current-main precedent for bundled Control UI plugin tabs and is the strongest visible routing signal for dashboard product direction.
